topics.name: Vacc
topics.desc: Saudi MOH National Immunization Schedule (uploaded older edition); verify current guidance

cards.q: How often is influenza vaccination given?
cards.a: One dose annually.

cards.q: How often is a Td booster given to adults?
cards.a: Every 10 years after a Tdap dose.

cards.q: When is Tdap recommended during pregnancy?
cards.a: Once per pregnancy, between 27 and 36 weeks.

cards.q: Who should receive MMR if immunity is absent?
cards.a: Unvaccinated people without evidence of immunity or prior disease.

cards.q: How many MMR doses may be needed in susceptible adults?
cards.a: One or two doses, depending on indication.

cards.q: What is the varicella vaccine schedule for nonimmune adults?
cards.a: Two doses, 8 weeks apart, per the supplied schedule.

cards.q: Who is targeted for herpes zoster vaccination in this schedule?
cards.a: Adults aged 50 years or older.

cards.q: What zoster dose interval is shown in this schedule?
cards.a: Two doses, 2–6 months apart.

cards.q: Which HPV age group is listed for catch-up vaccination?
cards.a: Females aged 15–26 years, in the supplied schedule.

cards.q: What is the HPV catch-up dosing schedule shown?
cards.a: Three doses at 0, 1–2, and 6 months.

cards.q: What does PPSV23 stand for?
cards.a: 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine.

cards.q: What does PCV stand for?
cards.a: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine.

cards.q: Which adults are listed for PPSV23 vaccination?
cards.a: Adults ≥65 years and adults with specified comorbidities or immunocompromise.

cards.q: What does the schedule say about PCV for adults ≥65?
cards.a: One dose, or catch-up after prior PCV13 depending on history.

cards.q: What is the adult hepatitis B schedule shown?
cards.a: Three doses at 0, 1, and 6 months if not previously immunized or immunity is absent.

cards.q: How often is the MCV4 booster given if risk persists?
cards.a: Every 5 years, after an indicated initial dose.

cards.q: What does MCV4 protect against?
cards.a: Meningococcal serogroups A, C, W, and Y.

cards.q: Which vaccine is recommended annually in the adult table?
cards.a: Influenza vaccine.

cards.q: Which vaccine is specifically timed in each pregnancy?
cards.a: Tdap.

cards.q: What is the difference between Tdap and Td?
cards.a: Tdap includes pertussis protection; Td contains tetanus and diphtheria toxoids.
